params.name: st
params.description: State, must be one of `open`, `forthcoming` or `closed`

params.name: au
params.description: Audience ID, must be one of the audiences configured on the site

params.name: in
params.description: Interest ID, must be one of the interests configured on the site

params.name: de
params.description: Department the activity sits within. Value must be the same as the ID of a department within the site

params.name: ar
params.description: Area ID, must be one of the areas configured on the site

params.name: dk
params.description: Date search type, must be one of `op` (open date) and `cl` (close date)

params.name: fd
params.description: Date to search from. Must be used in conjunction with `dk` (dd/mm/yyyy)

params.name: td
params.description: Date to search until. Must be used in conjunction with `dk` (dd/mm/yyyy)

params.name: at
params.description: Activity type. Must be one of the activity types available to the site.

params.name: ct
params.description: (deprecated) Legacy activity type. Must be one of `QuickConsult` (Online Survey), `File` (Email/Postal Activity), `Document` (Offline Activity), or `Link` (Link)

params.name: fields
params.description: Determines which groups of metadata fields about the activities will be returned. Permissible values are 'basic', 'extended' and 'all'. Omitting this parameter is equivalent to 'basic'.

items.docs: Accepts any of the documented search parameters. If no arguments are supplied, all published activities are returned. Any unsupported arguments are ignored. Returns a JSON array of activity objects.

info.name: Get one consultation activity by department and activity ID

params.name: fields
params.description: Determines which groups of metadata fields about the activities will be returned. Permissible values are 'basic', 'extended' and 'all'. Omitting this parameter is equivalent to 'basic'.

items.docs: Returns a JSON structure containing the same fields as json_search_results. If dept or id are not specified or do not exist, a 404 status code is returned.
